title: Revise the criteria for designating DPI-H components
requirements:
- Define 'foundational health system functions' more precisely, e.g. with a dependency or irreplaceability test
- Remove or reword 'non-transactional' so high-volume infrastructural services (consent, registries) are not excluded
- Reword 'without modification to core design' to allow configuration, content and localisation while the core stays stable
- Reword the non-transactional requirement so it does not exclude legitimate shared transactional infrastructure
- Treat recurrence across goals as one criterion among several
- Express the intended distinction as not owning point-of-service or programme-specific transaction processing
- Define stability as predictable, versioned evolution of purpose and interfaces
- Clarify whether public governance is a present or target condition
